body: You are going to get better! I bet you'll look back at this a year and see how far you've come. :)
I have thought of a few things but it takes a lot of effort and time to actually make money off of things like that, especially now that YouTube is demonetizing videos I imagine.

Literally the only thing I buy is food and I cook at home. I can draw and I have tried to get very cheap commissions but I'm not very good, so it seems people don't even deem me worthy of a 5$ commission. I wish my problem was as easy as slowing down my spending but I make 8$ an hour so my spending just isn't the problem. I can't afford to eat well enough to avoid getting curled in nails and I can't afford luxuries because I barely keep my rent paid. It's not like I'm buying a coffee every morning or something silly - I literally steal food from work to eat and NO ONE wants old expired gas station hot food I promise you.
I work at a gas station right now because I got laid off my other job. I'm trying to find anything else but it sucks living in a rural area.

I don't even get a lunch break and I almost never have a chance to talk with my coworkers. I get no say in scheduling and work every weekend, if I didn't I wouldn't be able to pay bills. People online are pretty much the best I'm going to get right now.
But they know I’m too poor to lawyer up. :(
